_comment: Edit this file to add/remove job sources. No code changes needed. After editing, the next scheduled GitHub Action run picks it up (or run it manually from the Actions tab).
_hard_rule: max_days_old is a hard cap - the fetcher DROPS anything older, on every source, because expired postings can't be detected reliably. Keep it at 7 unless you have a reason.
_configured_for: Environmental technician / ecological restoration / GIS / field & lab roles, plus educational-assistant & science-teaching roles, in the Toronto / GTA area, transit-accessible (no personal vehicle).
_vehicle_rule: The site owner drives (Ontario G2) but has no vehicle of their own. The fetcher flags a job only if its text requires the applicant's OWN vehicle ('own/personal/reliable vehicle', 'access to a vehicle', 'provide your own transportation') OR a FULL Class G licence (not G2). The site hides flagged jobs by default. A plain 'valid driver's licence', 'G2 acceptable', crew transport, or a provided company/fleet vehicle is NOT flagged.
_relocation_rule: Temp/seasonal/contract: GTA only (no relocating for a short contract). Permanent/full-time: GTA preferred but out-of-GTA permanent roles are surfaced in a separate section. Out-of-GTA seasonal roles are dropped entirely.

sources.note: CONFIRMED WORKING (2026-09-01). Canada's aggregator - pulls from Jobillico, CareerBeacon, direct employers, some government. One request per search term. NOTE: the RSS feed only returns the ~13 most recent postings per term (no pagination), so on a 6-hourly schedule it captures new jobs as they appear but a cold start only sees the last day or two. No closing dates in the feed - these jobs rely on the 7-day cap. Lots of Quebec results for generic terms; the site filters by location client-side.

Free API, big coverage + salary data. Register at https://developer.adzuna.com/signup and add ADZUNA_APP_ID / ADZUNA_APP_KEY as GitHub repo secrets. Skipped automatically if the secrets are missing - everything else still runs.

CONFIRMED WORKING (2026-09-03). Canada's conservation & wildlife jobs board (WP Job Manager feed). Carries structured job_listing:company / job_listing:location / job_listing:salary tags. Location is a coarse region ('Central Canada', 'North', 'Other') not a city - 'Central Canada' passes the Canadian filter, the rest are out-of-GTA and correctly dropped. Strong local coverage: conservation authorities (Credit Valley, Grand River, TRCA), Ontario Nature, EcoSpark, Earth Rangers. Feed returns the ~10-30 newest postings, no pagination.

Public Greenhouse boards, one slug per org (the <slug> in job-boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>). Wrong slugs are skipped silently. Check whether your target ENGOs / research institutes use Greenhouse before adding.

NO PUBLIC FEED as of 2026-09. GoodWork only offers email alerts, not RSS. Covering it means HTML scraping, which breaks whenever they restyle the page. Many GoodWork postings also appear on Job Bank / Adzuna. Ask Claude to build a scraper for it as a follow-up if you want it anyway.
NO PUBLIC FEED as of 2026-09 (ecoworks.eco.ca - custom platform, email alerts only). Same situation as GoodWork - needs scraping.
UNVERIFIED URL - Canadian academic job board. Confirm the real feed URL (look for an RSS link on universityaffairs.ca/search-job) then set enabled to true.
UNVERIFIED URL - has Canada listings, usually offers RSS. Confirm and enable.
Nonprofit sector (many environmental NGOs post here). Look for a jobs RSS on charityvillage.com, paste it, enable.

Conservation Job Board (conservationjobboard.com) - has US+CA, check for RSS
